[quote=wooloo;60883168]It can be both; it largely depends on context.

For example, the Nationality "German" would be all people who are citizens of the Federal Republic of Germany
(The definition of nationality is "the status of belonging to a particular nation.")

While the ethnicity "German" refers to all Germans living in countries such as Austria, Germany, and Switzerland, as well as separate Germanic linguistic groups like Saxons and Bavarians. And German diaspora groups like German Americans.

The literal definition of ethnicity is "a shared cultural heritage, including language, religion, and traditions, that connects a group of people through a common ancestry and histor.y"[/quote]
True it is sometimes a grey area.
